ST. BONAVENTURE'S MONASTERY 1740 MT. ELLIOTT AVENUE DETROIT, MICH.
October 22nd, 1943
To Whom It May Concern. The bearer, Mrs. Margaret Fredette has been coming to Church here - with her family - for several years and is good honest person.
Sincerely yours,
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
